title: Aristomenes
summary: Raleigh names Aristomenes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aristomenes, a noble Gentleman of the house of Aepytus, Generall of the Messenians in the second Warre, who died at Rhodes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. IV, sig. 365b
